_meta.title: As Above, So Below — structured extract (Marie Satori, 2023)
_meta.provenance: Verbatim from Marie Satori, 'As Above, So Below: A Guide to Astrology for Tarot Readers' (2023), clean .docx export.
_meta.note_already_authored: planet-in-house (cc-planet-in-house-reviewed, 120) and transit-through-house (cc-transit-house) are already complete in the phrasebank; this book file is a CONFIRMED enrichment/reference source, not a replacement. Aspects, ingresses, and full/new-moon-by-sign are NOT in the book (gaps to fill from articles).

saturn.aries: When Saturn resides in Aries, your life lessons center around self–assertion and individuality. Discipline and patience become tools you need to master to overcome impulsive actions. You learn to cultivate the courage to take the lead and stand up for yourself without being overly confrontational.
saturn.taurus: Saturn in Taurus prompts you to build a practical approach to material and financial security. It encourages you to avoid impulsive spending and prioritize stability through hard work and perseverance.
saturn.gemini: Saturn in Gemini places the focus on your communication skills. You're compelled to refine your way of thinking and expressing yourself. You may face challenges in conveying your thoughts initially, but with time and effort, you can become an effective and articulate communicator.
saturn.cancer: With Saturn in Cancer, your lessons revolve around emotional expression and matters of the home. You're pushed to create a solid foundation for your personal life while balancing your need for emotional security. You may need to address issues of emotional dependency or excessive self–protection.
saturn.leo: With Saturn in Leo, you're challenged to balance your need for recognition with humility. You'll learn lessons about pride and humility, and how to express your individuality in a way that recognizes others' contributions as well.
saturn.virgo: Saturn in Virgo requires you to focus on the finer details of life. You're asked to perfect your work, health, and daily routines. With patience and consistent effort, you can become proficient in whatever area you put your mind to.
saturn.libra: Saturn in Libra calls for lessons in relationships and fairness. You're learning to balance your needs with those of others, establishing partnerships that are both fair and fulfilling. Patience and compromise become essential skills for you to master.
saturn.scorpio: With Saturn in Scorpio, you're urged to explore the deeper, more intense aspects of life. You're likely to face lessons regarding transformation and letting go of past hurts. Overcoming fears and embracing change will be key themes for you.
saturn.sagittarius: Saturn in Sagittarius has you focusing on truth, wisdom, and philosophy. You're pushed to explore your beliefs, learn from different cultures, and expand your worldview. It's about understanding the biger picture and integrating this knowledge into your life.
saturn.capricorn: As Capricorn is Saturn's home sign, you're learning the values of discipline, responsibility, and structure. You're likely to face challenges that test your endurance and dedication, but these trials can shape you into a resilient and dependable individual.
saturn.aquarius: Saturn in Aquarius propels you towards understanding the needs of the collective and your role within it. You'll face lessons in friendship, group dynamics, and humanitarian ideals. Embracing your individuality while contributing to society can be a delicate balance for you to find.
saturn.pisces: Saturn in Pisces urges you to face lessons in compassion, intuition, and spiritual understanding. You're asked to navigate your dreams and illusions while staying grounded in reality. Developing a spiritual discipline can help you integrate these energies in a healthy way. Saturn (The World) in the natal 1st House (The Emperor) The 1st house is ruled by Aries and corresponds to The Emperor. The combination of The World (Saturn) and The Emperor (Aries/1st House) invites you to embrace your inner authority, lead with confidence, and take charge of your life. jupiter.aries: When Jupiter is in Aries in your chart, it amplifies your confidence and initiative. You find yourself blessed with an increased drive to conquer new territories and champion causes, and you have the potential to lead and inspire others with your enthusiasm.
jupiter.taurus: With Jupiter in Taurus, you may find your fortunes linked to perseverance and practicality. Opportunities for growth and expansion might be found in the financial and material realms, encouraging you to seek security and luxury while still appreciating the value of hard work.
jupiter.gemini: Jupiter in Gemini in your chart heightens your curiosity and thirst for knowledge. You may find yourself drawn to diverse areas of interest, and are likely to excel in any field that requires communication, networking, or learning new skills.
jupiter.cancer: When Jupiter resides in Cancer, you'll find your emotional intuition amplified. You're blessed with a nurturing spirit and an ability to create a sense of home and community wherever you go. You might also find luck when dealing with real estate or family matters.
jupiter.leo: With Jupiter in Leo, you're bestowed with an enhanced sense of creativity, charm, and leadership. You're likely to shine in the spotlight and succeed in endeavors where your unique talents and charisma can be put on full display.
jupiter.virgo: Jupiter in Virgo in your chart may bring forth growth through service and meticulous work. You have an enhanced ability to improve your surroundings and can find fulfillment and luck in your quest for efficiency and health.
jupiter.libra: If Jupiter is in Libra, you're blessed with a keen sense of balance and diplomacy. Opportunities might abound in partnerships and social settings, and you're likely to excel in situations that require compromise, negotiation, or artistic sense.
jupiter.scorpio: Jupiter in Scorpio sugests a depth of emotional understanding and transformative potential. You can gain wisdom and luck through exploring the hidden realms of life, delving deep into matters of shared resources, or investigating the mysteries of existence.
jupiter.sagittarius: As Jupiter rules Sagittarius, here it expresses its most expansive and adventurous tendencies. Your horizon is broadened through travel, higher learning, or philosophical exploration. You may find yourself drawn to quests for truth and meaning, and the universe often rewards your optimism and wanderlust.
jupiter.capricorn: With Jupiter in Capricorn, it rewards patience, discipline, and ambition. You can find success through hard work, good organization, and the pursuit of long – term goals. Your leadership skills and business acumen are enhanced, often leading to professional growth.
jupiter.aquarius: With Jupiter in Aquarius, you're blessed with visionary insight and a knack for innovative thinking. You might excel in teamwork and community – based projects, and your interests in humanitarian or technological fields could bring unexpected opportunities.
jupiter.pisces: Finally, Jupiter in Pisces heightens your empathy, intuition, and spiritual inclinations. You may find luck and expansion through artistic pursuits, acts of compassion, or spiritual exploration. Your understanding of the interconnectedness of all beings may serve as a source of wisdom and inspiration. Jupiter (The Wheel of Fortune) in the natal 1st House (The Emperor) Jupiter in the 1st house of the natal chart signifies a powerful and expansive energy that influences your sense of self, personal growth, and how you project yourself to the world. This placement bestows you with a natural aura

mars.aries: With Mars in Aries, you're blessed with a surge of energy and assertiveness. You act with confidence and a pioneering spirit, eager to forge your own path. Q_uick decisions and rapid action are your signatures.
mars.taurus: Mars in Taurus lends you a steady, persistent drive. You tackle tasks with determination, and once you've set a goal, it's near impossible to deter you. Patience and a love for the sensual pleasures of life mark your journey.
mars.gemini: With Mars in Gemini in your chart, your actions are powered by your intellect. Q_uick – thinking and versatility guide your moves. You may be drawn towards activities that involve communication, networking, or learning new skills.
mars.cancer: When Mars is in Cancer, your actions are motivated by emotion and intuition. You protect what you hold dear with a fierce determination. While you may approach situations cautiously, once you commit, you invest deep emotional energy.
mars.leo: Mars in Leo gives you a flair for the dramatic. Your actions often attract attention, and you carry out your tasks with a sense of pride and a desire for recognition. Your energy levels are consistently high, and you face life with a courageous heart.
mars.virgo: With Mars in Virgo, you act with precision and practicality. You have an acute eye for detail and a desire for perfection. Your energy is applied in service, organization, and tasks that require meticulous attention.
mars.libra: Your actions are characterized by your desire for balance and harmony. You are motivated to act fairly, and you might find yourself in the role of a mediator. You may also have a knack for artistic pursuits.
mars.scorpio: You act with intensity and a strong will. Your actions are often guided by your deep intuition, and you're not afraid to explore the hidden depths of any situation.
mars.sagittarius: If Mars is in Sagittarius, your actions embody an adventurous spirit. You relish taking risks and exploring new frontiers. Guided by optimism and enthusiasm, you're always prepared for the next big adventure.
mars.capricorn: With Mars is in Capricorn, your actions are driven by your ambition and discipline. You have a strong work ethic and the patience to achieve your long – term goals. You act with practicality, and a strong sense of responsibility.
mars.aquarius: Mars in Aquarius bestows upon you a unique, innovative drive. You act based on your strong ideals and are willing to challenge the status quo. You may be drawn towards activities that benefit society as a whole or involve cutting–edge technology.
mars.pisces: With Mars in Pisces, your actions are motivated by your empathy and intuition. You have a selfless desire to help and heal. Your actions might be guided by your deep spiritual beliefs or a strong sense of creative inspiration. Mars (The Tower) in the natal 1st House (The Emperor) With Mars, The Tower, in your 1st house in your natal chart, you possess a dynamic, shocking and assertive energy that leaves a lasting impression on others. The 1st house is ruled by Aries and corresponds to The Emperor. Your strong sense of self and natural leadership abilities make you a force to be reckoned with.

sun.aries: With your Sun in Aries, you radiate energy and courage. You have a pioneering spirit, a love of competition, and a knack for initiating new projects. You value your independence and aren't afraid to walk your path boldly and confidently.
sun.taurus: As a Taurus Sun, you exude steadiness, reliability, and a deep connection with the physical world. You appreciate beauty and comfort, and you're likely to build a life that engages your senses. You show your tenacity in achieving goals and can be quite unyielding once your mind is set.
sun.gemini: With your Sun in Gemini, you embody versatility, curiosity, and a need for variety. Communication is your forte, and you shine when sharing ideas or gathering knowledge. Your mutable nature makes you adaptable, and you're often drawn to activities that involve a fair degree of mental stimulation.
sun.cancer: As a Cancer Sun, you exude nurturing energy and emotional sensitivity. You highly value family and home and take pride in caring for loved ones. You're guided by your emotions and intuition, and you have an innate ability to provide comfort and security to those around you.
sun.leo: With your Sun in Leo, you radiate warmth, generosity, and a zest for life. Your presence is often magnetic, drawing others to you naturally. You shine when expressing your creativity and have a strong drive for personal recognition and a desire to be at the center of attention.
sun.virgo: As a Virgo Sun, you personify efficiency, practicality, and a focus on service. You're detail–oriented and often drawn to tasks that involve analysis or helping others. You shine when precision and care are needed, and your work ethic is second to none.
sun.libra: With your Sun in Libra, you reflect balance, harmony, and a knack for partnership. You are socially oriented, often striving to create peace and fairness in your surroundings. Your charm and diplomatic skills allow you to navigate relationships with grace and ease.
sun.scorpio: As a Scorpio Sun, you emanate depth, transformation, and intensity. You thrive on emotional intimacy and are unafraid to dive into life's more profound mysteries. Your determination is unyielding, and your passions run deep, allowing you to navigate life's ups and downs with resilience.
sun.sagittarius: With your Sun in Sagittarius, you reflect a love of freedom, adventure, and truth–seeking. You're drawn to exploring life's big questions and aren't afraid to roam far and wide in your search for answers. Your optimistic nature and broad–minded outlook make you a natural philosopher.
sun.capricorn: As a Capricorn Sun, you exude discipline, ambition, and a strong sense of responsibility. You have a natural knack for management and strategy, and you shine when setting long–term goals. Your practical and cautious approach to life is often a model of success for others.
sun.aquarius: With your Sun in Aquarius, you embody individuality, innovation, and a deep sense of humanitarianism. You thrive on uniqueness and often seek to challenge the status quo. You shine in situations where you can utilize your inventive mind and make a difference in the world.
sun.pisces: As a Pisces Sun, you emanate empathy, spiritual depth, and a strong intuitive sense. You are in tune with the collective unconscious and often show a selfless desire to help others. Your imaginative and compassionate nature allows you to navigate the world with grace and sensitivity. Sun in the natal 1st House (The Sun & The Emperor) The Sun symbolizes your essential self, your life energy, your spirit, and your conscious identity. venus.aries: With Venus in Aries, you love passionately, thriving on challenges and the excitement of vibrant, competitive romance. You express affection with an adventurous spirit, cherishing spontaneous and enthusiastic displays of love.
venus.taurus: With Venus in Taurus, you are all about sensuality and tangible expressions of love. You are drawn to comfort, stability, and pleasure. You value fidelity and consistency, enjoying a slow–burning romance that gradually builds over time.
venus.gemini: With Venus in Gemini, your love life is marked by curiosity and excitement. Intellectual conversations captivate you, and a mental connection is often a prerequisite for romance. You value variety and intellectual compatibility in relationships.
venus.cancer: With Venus in Cancer, your love is nurturing, protective, and deep. Home and family are central to your sense of comfort and security in a relationship.
venus.leo: With Venus in Leo, your love is dramatic, warm, and generous. You appreciate grand gestures of love and seek to be adored and admired in your relationships. You are drawn to people who are confident and expressive, and you enjoy sharing a glamorous social life with your partner.
venus.virgo: With Venus in Virgo, your affection is shown through practical means. You value stability and show your love by taking care of the small details that contribute to your partner's wellbeing. Your love language often involves acts of service, and you seek meaningful and productive relationships.
venus.libra: With Venus in Libra, you value balance, harmony, and partnership in love. You are diplomatic and fair–minded in your relationships and are drawn to beauty and charm. Your sense of romance involves a deep appreciation for cooperation and shared experiences.
venus.scorpio: With Venus in Scorpio, your love is intense, passionate, and transformative. You seek deep emotional bonding and are drawn to mysteries and the hidden depths of your partner. Your relationships are profoundly intimate, reflecting your desire for deep emotional exchange.
venus.sagittarius: With Venus in Sagittarius, your love is adventurous, optimistic, and freedom-loving. You prioritize honesty, intellectual stimulation, and shared adventures in relationships. You're drawn to open-minded individuals who can broaden your horizons and share your zest for life.
venus.capricorn: With Venus in Capricorn, your love is mature, loyal, and somewhat reserved. You value practicality and reliability, preferring to show your affection through steadfast support and shared ambitions.
venus.aquarius: With Venus in Aquarius, your love is free–spirited, intellectual, and somewhat unconventional. You value friendship and shared ideals in your relationships, and you're attracted to those who stimulate your mind and respect your need for independence.
venus.pisces: With Venus in Pisces, your love is compassionate, imaginative, and selfless. You value emotional connection and spiritual bonding, often showing your affection through empathetic understanding and selfless acts of kindness. You're attracted to those who can share in your dreamy, romantic visions. Venus (The Empress) in the natal 1st House (The Emperor) The 1st house in astrology, ruled by Aries—the pioneering trailblazer of the zodiac—encapsulates your sense of self, identity, and how you approach the world. mercury.aries: With Mercury in Aries, your communication is direct, assertive, and enthusiastic. You think on your feet, making you a natural problem-solver. You tackle intellectual challenges with boldness and excitement.
mercury.taurus: With Mercury in Taurus, your communication style is measured, grounded, and practical. You think things through thoroughly before voicing your opinions, and your words are typically well – considered and reliable.
mercury.gemini: With Mercury in Gemini, you're quick-witted and express thoughts eloquently. Skilled in conversation, you're always ready to exchange ideas. Your adaptable and curious mind enjoys exploring multiple subjects.
mercury.cancer: With Mercury in Cancer, your thinking process is profoundly influenced by your emotions. Your communication is intuitive, nurturing, and often indirect. You excel in understanding and conveying emotional subtleties.
mercury.leo: With Mercury in Leo, your communication style is bold, creative, and confident. You're good at expressing your thoughts in dramatic and compelling ways. You enjoy being the center of attention, engaging others with your vivacious and charismatic speech.
mercury.virgo: With Mercury in Virgo, your thoughts are analytical, detailed, and practical. You excel at problem – solving and critical thinking. You communicate clearly, logically, and you're good at giving useful advice.
mercury.libra: With Mercury in Libra, your thinking process is balanced, diplomatic, and harmonious. You excel in mediating and finding fair solutions in conversations. You enjoy intellectual exchanges that involve give – and – take.
mercury.scorpio: With Mercury in Scorpio, your communication is intense, probing, and insightful. You uncover truths and delve into deep topics, preferring meaningful conversations over small talk.
mercury.sagittarius: With Mercury in Sagittarius, your communication is optimistic, broad-minded, and sincere. You're a seeker of knowledge, engaging in philosophical and thought-provoking conversations. Your expression is open and honest.
mercury.capricorn: With Mercury in Capricorn, your communication is clear, organized, and serious. You're good at strategic thinking and planning. Your words are chosen carefully and are often laced with practical wisdom.
mercury.aquarius: With Mercury in Aquarius, your thinking is innovative, idealistic, and somewhat unconventional. You enjoy intellectual exchanges about progressive ideas. You have the ability to communicate your unique ideas effectively.
mercury.pisces: With Mercury in Pisces, your communication is empathetic, imaginative, and intuitive. Your thinking process is often influenced by your feelings. You're good at expressing ideas creatively and understanding others on an emotional level. Mercury (The Magician) in the natal 1st House (The Emperor) With Mercury in your 1st house, also known as the Ascendant or the house of self, your communication style and thought processes are deeply intertwined with your individuality and self–expression. uranus.aries: Signifies impulsivity and innovation. Those with this placement may be pioneers and groundbreakers, often inclined to challenge the status quo.
uranus.taurus: Indicates a desire for materialistic progress and financial innovation. Those with this placement can bring revolutionary changes in fields related to finance and the environment.
uranus.gemini: Implies an innovative mind with unique communication styles. Those with this placement may invent or create revolutionary ideas in media, technology, or education.
uranus.cancer: Sugests new ideas and drastic changes in terms of home, family, and traditions. Those with this placement may redefine conventional notions of family and domesticity.
uranus.leo: Represents unique and innovative expressions of creativity and leadership. Those with this placement may revolutionize arts, entertainment, and leadership roles.
uranus.virgo: Signifies advancements and revolutionary changes in healthcare and service sectors. Those with this placement may pioneer new methods in these fields.
uranus.libra: Implies innovation in diplomacy, relationships, and art. Those with this placement may challenge traditional norms in these areas.
uranus.scorpio: Sugests drastic transformations, often through trials and upheavals. Those with this placement may bring about radical changes in fields like psychology, metaphysics, or finance.
uranus.sagittarius: Represents radical philosophy and exploration. Those with this placement may challenge established beliefs, ethics, or educational systems.
uranus.capricorn: Indicates a revolutionary approach to structures, systems, and governance. Those with this placement may bring about radical changes in traditional structures like governance, corporations, or societal hierarchy.
uranus.aquarius: Emphasizes individuality, freedom, and humanitarianism. Those with this placement may bring about revolutionary changes for the collective.
uranus.pisces: Signifies spirituality, intuition, and universal love. Those with this placement may introduce innovative ideas in the realms of spirituality, art, or healing. Transiting Uranus opposes its natal position typically between the ages of 38 and 45. Those born in the 1930s to 1940s will experience this transit earlier, around ages 38 to 41. Individuals born in the 1960s, 1970s, and 1980s will undergo this transit slightly later, between ages 41 and 45. neptune.aries: Indicates a generation with a desire for spiritual independence and self-expression, often exploring individuality through mystical or artistic pursuits.
neptune.taurus: Sugests a longing for a spiritual connection with the material world. Those with this placement may find inspiration and transcendence through nature, music, or sensory experiences.
neptune.gemini: Implies an imaginative and dreamy mind, often inclined towards creative writing, communication, or spiritual studies. This placement may bring forth a fascination with diverse perspectives and spiritual exploration.
neptune.cancer: Signifies a deep emotional connection to the spiritual realm, often seeking solace and guidance through intuition, dreams, or ancestral connections. This placement may indicate a strong empathetic nature.
neptune.leo: Represents an artistic and dramatic expression of spirituality. Those with this placement may find transcendence through creative self-expression, performance arts, or the exploration of divine inner light.
neptune.virgo: Sugests a practical and analytical approach to spirituality. This placement may inspire a pursuit of healing, service, or perfectionism through holistic practices or spiritual rituals.
neptune.libra: Indicates a yearning for harmony, peace, and balance in spiritual experiences and relationships. Those with this placement may be drawn to partnerships that uplift and inspire their spiritual growth.
neptune.scorpio: Signifies a deep, transformative, and sometimes mystical connection to the hidden realms. This placement may bring intense spiritual experiences, psychic abilities, or an interest in esoteric knowledge.
neptune.sagittarius: Implies a quest for higher truth and expansive spiritual experiences. Those with this placement may have a strong inclination towards spiritual exploration, philosophy, or seeking spiritual guidance from diverse cultures.
neptune.capricorn: Sugests a disciplined and structured approach to spirituality. This placement may inspire individuals to pursue spiritual practices that bring stability, wisdom, and a strong sense of purpose.
neptune.aquarius: Represents a collective and progressive approach to spirituality. Those with this placement may be drawn to unconventional spiritual beliefs, humanitarian causes, or spiritual insights that challenge societal norms.
neptune.pisces: Signifies a strong connection to the spiritual realm and a deep sense of empathy. This placement may bring heightened intuition, psychic abilities, and a profound spiritual connection to the universal consciousness. pluto.taurus: Sugests a generation with a strong focus on material transformation, financial matters, and building lasting foundations. This placement can bring profound changes in areas related to wealth, resources, and values.
pluto.gemini: Implies a generation with a transformative approach to communication, information, and intellectual pursuits. This placement can bring deep changes in the realms of learning, technology, and global connectivity.
pluto.cancer: Signifies a generation with a deep emotional depth and transformative experiences related to home, family, and roots. This placement can bring intense changes in personal and familial dynamics.

pluto.scorpio: Signifies a generation with intense transformative experiences, emotional depth, and a desire for profound change. This placement can bring deep transformations in areas related to power, sexuality, and spirituality.
pluto.sagittarius: Implies a generation with transformative experiences in the realms of higher knowledge, belief systems, and philosophical pursuits. This placement can bring profound changes in areas related to travel, spirituality, and cultural understanding.
pluto.capricorn: Sugests a generation with transformative experiences in the realms of authority, career, and structure. This placement can bring deep changes in areas related to governance, social systems, and ambition.

empty_houses.1: Projecting your external identity comes naturally to you, minimizing the effort required to put yourself forward. Insights into further strengths and weaknesses can be uncovered by examining your Ascendant and its governing planet.
empty_houses.2: Like a river that flows effortlessly, your connection with finances and income comes with an enviable grace. Security and stability do not shake you.
empty_houses.3: Your words, your expressions, are like well-crafted melodies – clear and soothing. Conversing and articulating is a dance you know all too well, an endeavor where you hardly stumble. To dig deeper into the rhythm of your thoughts and speech, take a look to where Mercury has positioned itself in your chart.
empty_houses.4: Where others might find thorns, you discover roses. Family issues, a common human predicament, seem to weigh less heavily on your shoulders. You navigate the intricate map of home and familial ties with more ease than most, reminding us all of the strength found in tenderness.
empty_houses.5: Like an artist painting with ease, your expressions of love and creativity are vibrant and flow without restraint. To unlock deeper understanding of your connection with matters like children, art, and romance, look to see the ruler of your Fifth House.
empty_houses.6: You glide through life's mundane yet essential tasks, such as scheduling, organizing, and health matters, like a boat sailing smoothly on a calm sea. With your Sixth House unoccupied, you approach daily work and obligations with a lightness, a graceful efficiency that others may envy.
empty_houses.7: An empty House of Relationships doesn't foretell a life of solitary reflection, far from it. Relationships aren't your life’s main focus or challenges. While love may bring its hard lessons, they are but whispers in the wind for you, a gentle stir rather than a storm in the tranquil waters of your Seventh House.
empty_houses.8: The planets signifies your natural ability to explore and navigate the depths of emotional complexity and intimacy. You possess a sense of ease and comfort in navigating these deeper, sometimes tumultuous, aspects of life.
empty_houses.9: You have a beautiful ease with seeing the big picture, expanding your mind and spirit in a multitude of ways. Without planets in the 9th house, you journey without the need to imprint your philosophical and spiritual beliefs on others, honoring the divine diversity of the Universe.
empty_houses.10: You find it easier to manage your career responsibilities and goals.
empty_houses.11: You find it easy and comfortable dealing with groups, communities, and friendships. As your Eleventh House also rules your hopes and wishes, examining the planet ruling your Eleventh House can provide further insight.
empty_houses.12: The hidden corners of the world seem less like a labyrinthine to you than to others. You discover that pathways to your unconscious, dreams, psychic capabilities, and the mystical universe unfold more effortlessly for you, allowing a freer exploration of these realms.

house_meanings.1: The first house the self (including the physical body), beginnings, and the initial emergence of human experience.
house_meanings.2: The second house where you begin to establish things that adorn the self: self–worth, self–esteem, possessions, values, money, foundation, ancestral gifts, and prestige.
house_meanings.3: The third house interpersonal, corresponding to communication, learning, short trips, early education, and an element of curiosity that is reflected in its correlation to childhood.
house_meanings.4: The fourth house as the "home of the heart," speaks to the deep and intimate connections we have with our family and our sense of belonging within our home and community.
house_meanings.5: The fifth house meticulous in their approach to their creative endeavors and may need to retreat from the world in order to focus on their work and perfect their craft.
house_meanings.6: The sixth house the “health” of the business and day – to – day operations; it is a time to focus on systems, structures, and routines.
house_meanings.7: The seventh house one – on – one interactions, and with Scorpio's energy in this house, you have the potential to create strong bonds with others.
house_meanings.8: The eighth house the house of other people’s money, death, joint resources, sex, and secrets.
house_meanings.9: The ninth house related to the expansion of the higher self through higher education, foreign travel, wisdom, philosophy, expansion, and higher thinking.
house_meanings.10: The tenth house the house of career, reputation, public image, ambition, and how you are known in the world.
house_meanings.11: The eleventh house a portal to the very essence of human connection and kindness.
house_meanings.12: The twelfth house a place of great enigma and mystique. It is the house of karma, of endings, of that which is hidden deep within the subconscious.
